latestVersion.changelog:
AI SEO skill debut focused on optimization for AI search engines and AI-generated answers.

- Provides actionable frameworks to boost citation by AI search platforms including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
- Introduces structured audit checklists to assess and improve AI search visibility, content extractability, and AI crawler access.
- Explains differences between traditional SEO and AI SEO, and outlines platform-specific source selection factors.
- Offers clear, practical recommendations for page structure, authority elements, schema, and robots.txt for AI-driven organic visibility.
